title: Description of the Reality of Creation Through the Tree Parable

questions.question: What image is used at the beginning of the passage to explain something hidden from sight?
questions.answer: A huge unusual tree hidden behind a veil is used as the main image.

questions.question: Why does the passage say there must be order and fit between a tree and its parts?
questions.answer: Because each part takes its form in a way that matches the nature of the whole tree.

questions.question: Which parts of the tree are named to show this inner harmony?
questions.answer: Its branches, fruits, leaves, and blossoms.

questions.question: What would an artist do on the veil to prove he truly knows the unseen tree?
questions.answer: He would draw each part in the right place and right proportion, from major parts to smaller ones, with exact fitting relationships.

questions.question: What conclusion would people reach about such an artist?
questions.answer: They would decide that he sees the hidden tree with a sight that reaches beyond the visible surface.

questions.question: In the comparison, what does the hidden tree stand for?
questions.answer: It stands for creation and the reality of all contingent beings.

questions.question: How wide is the created order described in the passage?
questions.answer: It stretches from the world's beginning to the far end of the hereafter, from the earth to the divine throne, and from tiny particles to the sun.

questions.question: What has the Qur'an preserved in its description of creation?
questions.answer: It has preserved the right proportion and fitting relation among all parts of existence.

questions.question: How did investigative scholars respond after examining these depictions?
questions.answer: They expressed amazement and gratitude to Allah and praised the Qur'an for explaining the universe's mystery.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest the Qur'an is able to solve or open up?
questions.answer: It opens the puzzle of the universe and the riddle of creation.

questions.question: What main claim about the Qur'an is being supported through the tree example?
questions.answer: That its descriptions are so exact and balanced that they show a knowledge beyond ordinary human reach.

questions.question: What kind of tree are readers asked to imagine?
questions.answer: A vast and extraordinary tree spread out widely but hidden in the unseen.

questions.question: What does the passage say is obvious about the connection between a tree and its members?
questions.answer: Their parts must relate to one another with harmony and balance.

questions.question: How is the human body used in the comparison?
questions.answer: It is mentioned as another example of how a whole and its members fit one another.

questions.question: What does each part of the imagined tree receive according to the passage?
questions.answer: A form and shape suited to the nature of the whole tree.

questions.question: If someone draws this tree correctly without seeing it directly, what feature of the drawing matters most?
questions.answer: The drawing must show exact proportion and proper relation from one part to another.

questions.question: Why is the distance between the source and end points in the drawing important?
questions.answer: It shows that even parts far apart are connected in a precise and meaningful way.

questions.question: According to the comparison, what does the Qur'an speak about with this same precision?
questions.answer: It speaks about the reality of created beings and the whole order of existence.

questions.question: What ranges are mentioned to show the scope of that order?
questions.answer: From the start of the world to the hereafter, from the earth to the divine throne, and from particles to the sun.

questions.question: What effect did the Qur'an's descriptions have on careful scholars?
questions.answer: They recognized the beauty and precision of its portrayals and praised Allah.

questions.question: What two things did those scholars say the Qur'an addresses?
questions.answer: The hidden code of the universe and the mystery of creation.

questions.question: What inference does the passage invite about the source of the Qur'an's knowledge?
questions.answer: Its knowledge must come from a reality that fully encompasses what is hidden and vast.

questions.question: What is concealed at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: A strange and immense tree is concealed behind a veil of the unseen.

questions.question: What qualities must exist among the tree's parts?
questions.answer: Mutual relation, harmony, and balance.

questions.question: Why is it significant that the tree has never been seen?
questions.answer: It makes an accurate drawing of it strong evidence of knowledge beyond normal observation.

questions.question: What would the person drawing on the veil map out first?
questions.answer: The members of the tree and the limits of each part.

questions.question: How does the drawing move from one part to another?
questions.answer: It goes from branches to fruit and from fruit to leaves in a measured and fitting way.

questions.question: What does this careful tracing prove about the artist?
questions.answer: It proves that the artist knows the hidden reality in a penetrating and comprehensive way.

questions.question: What does the Qur'an's discourse correspond to in this example?
questions.answer: It corresponds to the accurate depiction of the hidden tree.

questions.question: What name does the passage give to the whole created order?
questions.answer: It calls it the tree of creation.

questions.question: How does the passage show the enormous scale of this tree of creation?
questions.answer: It spans time, space, and levels of existence from the smallest things to the greatest.

questions.question: What did researchers conclude when they studied the Qur'an's presentation of this order?
questions.answer: They concluded that it is wonderfully fitting and that the Qur'an uniquely explains reality.

questions.question: What central idea about comprehension of the universe is emphasized here?
questions.answer: True understanding requires seeing how all parts of existence fit together in one balanced whole.

questions.question: What single metaphor organizes the whole target passage?
questions.answer: The metaphor of a hidden tree whose parts are drawn with perfect accuracy.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the shaping of each part of the tree?
questions.answer: Each part is shaped in line with the tree's own nature.

questions.question: Why would a correct sketch on the veil remove doubt?
questions.answer: Because such a sketch would reveal exact knowledge of something no one could see directly.

questions.question: What kind of relationships would have to appear in the drawing?
questions.answer: The relationships between all the parts, including their sizes, positions, and fitting connections.

questions.question: What human ability is being exceeded by the artist in the example?
questions.answer: Ordinary outward sight is being exceeded by a deeper, all-encompassing perception.

questions.question: In the second paragraph, what does the Qur'an describe with comparable exactness?
questions.answer: It describes the reality of all created and dependent beings.

questions.question: Which boundaries of existence are named in order to stress completeness?
questions.answer: The beginning of the world and the farthest end of the hereafter, the earth and the divine throne, and particles and the sun.

questions.question: What has the Qur'an done for the members and fruits of creation?
questions.answer: It has given them descriptions that fit them properly and keep their proportions intact.

questions.question: How do investigative scholars react to this level of order?
questions.answer: They respond with admiration, praise of Allah, and recognition of the Qur'an's wisdom.

questions.question: According to the scholars' response, what special role does the Qur'an play?
questions.answer: It serves as the one that unlocks the hidden meaning of the universe and creation.

questions.question: What is the main argument of the passage in one sentence?
questions.answer: The Qur'an's descriptions are so comprehensive and balanced that they point to perfect knowledge of the whole of creation.

questions.question: What are readers told to picture before the comparison is applied to the Qur'an?
questions.answer: They are told to picture a very large and unusual tree hidden behind a covering.

questions.question: What basic principle about living structure is stated through that picture?
questions.answer: A whole and its parts must match one another in an ordered and balanced way.

questions.question: Which examples of parts are listed to make that principle concrete?
questions.answer: Branches, fruit, leaves, and blossoms.

questions.question: What action does the imagined person perform on top of the veil?
questions.answer: He draws the hidden structure with exact boundaries and proper proportions.

questions.question: Why is the accuracy of these drawings so striking?
questions.answer: Because the object being drawn has not been seen openly.

questions.question: What judgment follows from that accuracy?
questions.answer: The person must possess sight or knowledge that reaches the hidden reality itself.

questions.question: How is this example then connected to the Qur'an?
questions.answer: The Qur'an is said to describe the whole order of created existence with the same kind of exact fit.

questions.question: What three paired ranges show the breadth of that created order?
questions.answer: World to hereafter, earth to divine throne, and particle to sun.

questions.question: What have scholars found when they studied these descriptions?
questions.answer: They found remarkable suitability and coherence in them.

questions.question: What kind of language do those scholars use in response?
questions.answer: They use words of wonder, praise, and thankfulness to Allah.

questions.question: What does their response imply about the Qur'an's insight?
questions.answer: It implies that the Qur'an has a uniquely deep understanding of the structure and meaning of existence.

questions.question: What unseen object is introduced in the passage as a teaching example?
questions.answer: An immense hidden tree spread out behind a veil.

questions.question: What three qualities connect the tree to its members?
questions.answer: Relationship, harmony, and balance.

questions.question: According to the passage, why does each part look the way it does?
questions.answer: Its shape is determined in agreement with the nature of the whole tree.

questions.question: What would someone need to do to represent that hidden tree convincingly?
questions.answer: He would need to draw every part accurately and connect distant parts in the right measure.

questions.question: What does the phrase about an eye reaching the unseen point to?
questions.answer: It points to penetrating knowledge of what is hidden from ordinary view.

questions.question: What does the tree symbolize when the passage applies the example?
questions.answer: It symbolizes the full reality of creation.

questions.question: How far does this reality of creation extend according to the passage?
questions.answer: Across all major levels of existence, from earliest worldly beginning to the furthest afterlife and from the smallest entities to celestial bodies.

questions.question: What has the Qur'an done so well in speaking about this reality?
questions.answer: It has maintained exact proportion and suitability among all parts and results of creation.

questions.question: Who is especially mentioned as recognizing this excellence?
questions.answer: Scholars who investigate deeply and examine these portrayals carefully.

questions.question: What do they praise about the Qur'an in particular?
questions.answer: They praise its ability to explain the hidden order and meaning of the universe.

questions.question: What broader conclusion does the passage encourage the reader to make?
questions.answer: That the Qur'an speaks from comprehensive knowledge that fully grasps the interconnected whole of creation.
